text:
Rowan (Design): Hey — need a quick copy review for the API key rotation confirmation modal. Users are unclear whether rotating will immediately break running workloads. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.mock/snap/rotate-key-modal.png

Current modal: header="Rotate API key?" body="Rotating your key will create a new key and revoke the old one. This is irreversible." primary="Rotate" secondary="Cancel"

Kris (ENG): Tech note: rotating issues a new key instantly and sets the old key to revoked immediately. Some services cache keys for a short TTL (up to 30s) depending on client libraries, so rotation can cause transient failures. Backend does provide a 30s grace header for some SDKs but not all.

Maya (Docs): Docs callout: we have a KB page: /docs/auth#rotate-keys that recommends rolling keys in staging first and updating CI secrets. We should link to it from the modal. Also prefer "revoke" wording only where precise. Saying "irreversible" is scary and not fully accurate.

Samira (A11y): Microcopy/accessibility: make the consequence explicit and concise. Screen reader folks prefer verbs up front. Suggest body: "Create a new key and revoke the current key immediately. Update any running services or CI that use this key; some clients may retry automatically." Also add role="alertdialog" and ensure focus lands on primary. If we include a checkbox "I understand this may cause downtime" make it keyboard accessible and required to enable primary.

Rowan (Design): Revised copy candidates:
- Option A (explicit): Header: "Rotate API key" Body: "Create a new key and immediately revoke the current one. Update any services, CI, or deployments that use this key. Some clients cache keys for a short time and may fail briefly. See docs for recommended rollout steps." Primary: "Rotate key" Secondary: "Cancel" Links: "Read rotation guide"
- Option B (safer): Header: "Rotate key and revoke old key" Body: "We'll issue a new key and immediately revoke the previous key. This can cause brief failures in services that cache keys. Consider rotating in staging first and update secrets before rotating in production." Primary: "Rotate and revoke" Secondary: "Cancel" Checkbox (optional): "I understand this may cause temporary failures"

Kris (ENG): Prefer Option A with an unobtrusive checkbox for high-risk orgs. Implementation note: if checkbox present, we should persist that consent for 5 minutes to avoid repetitively demanding confirmation when multiple keys rotated. Also surface a small inline ETA hint: "Keys take effect instantly (clients may retry for ~30s)."

Maya (Docs): I'll write the short docs blurb and add an anchor for the modal. Suggest link text: "Rotation guide (opens docs)" not just "docs". Also include a short checklist in the KB: update CI, rotate service tokens, verify health checks.

Samira (A11y): A11y nits: 1) If using checkbox, label should be descriptive, e.g., "I understand rotating may cause temporary service disruptions" 2) For screen readers, include sr-only contextual text with examples: "Examples: CI pipelines, webhooks, long-lived worker processes" 3) Make the modal dismissible with Escape and ensure focus returns to the rotate button that opened it. 4) Announce success with aria-live: "New key created. Old key revoked. Visit rotation guide for next steps."

Rowan (Design): Tone guide: avoid alarm words like "irreversible" and avoid scary punctuation. Keep sentences short and action-oriented. Also prefer present-tense verb-first CTA "Rotate key" over "Confirm rotate".

Kris (ENG): I'll implement the modal: Option A copy, small checkbox visible only for org roles with sensitive apps (config flag), persistent consent cookie for 5 minutes, and link to docs. I'll also add the inline ETA text and a copy of the new key shown once rotation completes (with copy-to-clipboard control). PR: https://git.redwood/pr/5510

ops-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.redwood-internal/mock/rotate-key-modal/v1 (expires in 48h) :package:

Maya (Docs): I'll add the KB anchor and a short checklist. Rowan, can you confirm final link text?

Rowan (Design): Confirming: Link text = "Rotation guide (opens docs)". Checkbox label = "I understand rotating may cause temporary service disruptions". Finalizing copy in the design file and component story.

Samira (A11y): I'll review the PR for focus handling and the sr-only examples. One tiny nit: use "temporary" not "brief" for SR clarity.

Kris (ENG): Updated PR with Samira's fix. Tagging @Rowan and @Maya for final review.

Rowan (Design): Thanks team  merging once a11y sign-off. :sparkles:
